title: MouseEventInputButton UI is really awkward
line: Adding or changing a desktop mouse action now explains what to click, warns when that button is already used, and Escape cancels it instead of closing the settings window.
explanation: After clicking "Add Action" (or an existing trigger) the button only said "Input Here", with no hint that you have to click it again with the wanted mouse button or scroll over it. Clicking with a button that another action already uses silently did nothing, and there was no way out of recording: Escape closed the whole settings dialog and discarded changes, which made it easy to replace a trigger by accident (the duplicate 482691 lost its right-click menu this way). Now the recording button reads "Click or Scroll Here", a message at the bottom of the page explains what to do (including modifier keys) and turns into a warning naming the trigger if it is already used, and Escape or moving focus elsewhere cancels recording without touching the dialog.

commits.message:
desktoppackage: make recording a mouse action trigger clearer

Recording showed only "Input Here", ignored used triggers silently and
could not be cancelled. A message now explains what to do and warns of
used triggers, and Escape or moving focus away cancels the recording.
